response.message: The Shawshank Redemption is available on Netflix (US, CA, GB), Amazon Prime Video (US, DE), and HBO Max (US).
Inception is available on Netflix (US, CA, AU), Amazon Prime Video (US, GB), and Disney+ (DE, FR).
The Matrix is available on Netflix (US, GB, JP), Amazon Prime Video (US, DE, FR), and Hulu (US).
